name: The End Fan Club

start.dialog: Omigosh! The Prism caves are PERFECT for a concert! The acoustics! The lighting! Help me set up? I need to find the perfect spot and spread the word! This is gonna be GREAT!
start.objective: Help Selphie find the perfect concert location in the Prism and distribute flyers

progress.dialog: The crystals really amplify the sound! And the light show potential! This is so exciting!
progress.objective: Distribute flyers to 10 NPCs in the Prism area

complete.dialog: The concert was AMAZING! Best ever! Thanks for all the help! Here - take this. It's a rare spell I found. 'The End' - super powerful! Just for you!

party_comments.kade: A concert in crystal caves. Actually... that sounds pretty cool.
party_comments.twist: That was the BEST CONCERT EVER! Wooo!
party_comments.nix7: Acoustic properties of Prism formations: exceptional.

hidden_outcome: If you get 20+ NPCs to attend (full house), Selphie gives you 'Strange Vision' - her ultimate nunchaku
